functions.name: na.roughfix
functions.done: Fills each missing entry with the column median.

check.case: a 4 by 2 matrix with two missing entries

proof.python:
import json
import statistics
import sys
import time

sys.path[:0] = ["/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/randomForest"]
from randomForest import margin, na_roughfix, outlier

def one():
    return [v for column in zip(*na_roughfix([[1, 10], [float('nan'), 2], [3, 6], [8, float('nan')]])) for v in column]

value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
if not isinstance(value, list):
    value = [value]
print(json.dumps({"value": value, "median_ms": statistics.median(elapsed)}))

functions.name: combine
functions.done: Predictions, importance, its standard deviation, and the tree sizes of two forests joined together. A missing out-of-bag prediction is compared as -1.

proof.r:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(randomForest))
if (packageDescription("randomForest")$Version != "4.7-1.2") stop("expected randomForest 4.7-1.2")
options(warn = -1)
json_num <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  x[is.na(x)] <- -1
  paste0("[", paste(sprintf("%.17g", x), collapse=","), "]")
}
y <- c(1.2, 0.4, 2.1, 1.7, 0.2, 3.3, 2.8, 0.9, 1.1, 4.0, 0.5, 2.2, 1.8, 3.1, 0.7, 2.6, 1.4, 0.3, 3.6, 2.0)
x <- matrix(c(1:60)/7, nrow=20, ncol=3)
newx <- matrix(c(2,9, 15,22, 30,41)/7, nrow=2)
xc <- matrix(c(1:48)/5, nrow=16, ncol=3)
yc <- factor(rep(c("b","a","b","a"), each=4))
reg <- function() randomForest(x, y, ntree=3, mtry=2, nodesize=5, importance=TRUE)

one <- function() {
  set.seed(2)
  fit <- reg()
  fit2 <- randomForest(x, y, ntree=2, mtry=2, nodesize=5, importance=TRUE)
  joined <- combine(fit, fit2)
  c(joined$predicted, as.numeric(joined$importance), joined$importanceSD, joined$forest$ndbigtree)
}
value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
cat(sprintf('{"value":%s,"median_ms":%.17g}\n', json_num(value), median(elapsed) * 1000))
